title: Frictional force (ঘর্ষণ বল)
placement: Book pages 88–89, topic 3.9: ঘর্ষণ বল (Frictional Force). Next to চিত্র ৩.১৫ (a block pushed on a table: F and the friction f) and চিত্র ৩.১৬ (the microscopic roughness of two touching surfaces).
description: A red 2 kg crate is pulled by an articulated person in an orange shirt and blue trousers, leaning away and gripping a horizontal rope. A saturated navy-to-teal scene separates the people, crate and large outlined force arrows. Orange tension and pink friction are equal and opposite while the crate is held; beyond the friction limit the crate accelerates, and after release friction slows it. Reverse the pull or add 1 kg weights to compare the threshold (9.8, 14.7, 19.6 N; one friction coefficient for this introductory lesson). An enlarged rectangular contact window is open by default: cyan and green particle markers follow the rough upper and lower surfaces, showing interlocking, compression and relative sliding. A qualitative warmth indicator rises during rubbing; particles and roughness are illustrative, not to scale, and no measured temperature is claimed. Two visible pullers alternate during the schematic back-and-forth rubbing demonstration. The compact panel shows force values, a short rule, one guided action and pause/replay controls. Five quiz scenes cover direction, balanced forces, weight, roughness and heating, with learning controls locked during assessment. Self-contained Three.js, Bangla first, with English and keyboard support.
